title: Dedicated capacity soft-launch: regional ops, docs sprint, and release-note sequencing
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
Run a controlled soft-launch of Dedicated capacity in a pilot region (eu-west-2) focused on ops readiness, documentation completeness, and release-note sequencing. Goal is to validate the end-to-end GTM playbook (billing SKU mapping, partner enablement, support runbooks) with minimal exposure and gather learnings before a broader roll.

Objectives:
1) Verify cross-team runbooks (infra, billing, support, sales engineering) are accurate and accessible.
2) Ship a consolidated release-notes package and docs sprint to close all remaining doc gaps.
3) Coordinate regional optics: pricing/sku mapping, subscription migration guide, and dashboard updates.
4) Capture metrics & runbook gaps from pilot within 72 hours of each launch wave.

Scope (in):
- Soft-launch for eu-west-2 Dedicated instance types (A100-40GB and T4x).
- Finalize release notes and doc pages: reservations FAQ, SKU matrix, billing mapping, and migration steps.
- Train support (Playbook + runbook drills) and Sales Engineering enablement session.
- Limited opt-in for 5 pilot customers (sales-identified).

Out of scope:
- Full GA marketing campaign and ALL-region rollout.
- Price adjustments post-soft-launch; those are product decisions after pilot.

Success metrics:
- Ops readiness score >= 85% in post-runbook checklist across infra, billing, and support.
- < 3 critical doc issues found in first 7 days post-launch.
- Pilot customer onboarding completed within SLAs for 4/5 customers.
- Release notes consumed by 90% of pilot customers (tracked via click-through metrics).

Acceptance criteria:
- Release-notes draft reviewed and approved by Legal, Security, and Billing.
- Support runbook stored in Console-Runbooks with clear escalation paths.
- Billing SKU mapping pushed to pricing-config and validated by Finance in staging.
- Internal announcement + enablement session scheduled and materials uploaded to Drive.

References and artifacts:
- Playbook draft (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Dedicated/Soft+Launch+Playbook+eu-west-2
- Release notes draft (Docs repo): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
- Billing SKU mapping (spreadsheet): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sku-mapping
- Pilot customer list (Sales): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/pilot-customers-eu
- Console dashboard tracking: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/dedicated-soft-launch
checklist: Finalize release-notes draft and gather Legal + Billing signoff
